propositions: Cross-module monkeypatch captures by-value imports at first-import time, causing ensures.canonical_tracker to permanently bind to a polluter test's lambda even after the patch is torn down

Victim tests invoke run_ensures with real trackers that get canonicalized to the polluter's dead tmpdir, bypassing gc.autoDetach and maintenance.autoDetach pins, leaving trackers unpinned for detached git maintenance
ensures.py is the only by-value importer of lock.canonical_tracker/write_lock/LockTimeout in src/rebar; other modules use late-binding via module import
Late-binding via 'from rebar._store import lock as _lock' and call-site dereferencing removes the import-capture hazard while maintaining production behavior
Regression test confirms patch-active first-import capture fails RED before the fix and passes GREEN after, with the oracle test still failing when trackers are genuinely unpinned
